title: Finite-frequency fluctuation-response bounds for open quantum systems
summary: We derive a finite-frequency fluctuation-response inequality for Markovian open quantum systems in an input-output setting. For any downstream measurement of the emitted field, the measured lock-in response-to-noise matrix is bounded by the output-field quantum Fisher information rate. For dissipative amplitude modulation with vacuum inputs, this information rate is further bounded by a frequency-independent signal-channel activity, which reduces for kinetic modulation to the stationary channel fluxes.
